title.en: Dynamic (absolute) Viscosity: Diesel 50 Concrete Pump keeps Diesel 50 prints it
title.zh: 动力粘度：印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30保留「该页印 15 m³/h。」

description.en: Diesel 50 Concrete Pump at /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump. Diesel 50 prints it The sheet prints 15 m³/h
description.zh: 印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30见 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump。该页印 15 m³/h。150 m / 450 m。

h1.en: Kinematic Viscosity is the heading; Diesel 50 Concrete Pump stays the subject
h1.zh: 标题是「运动粘度」，主体仍是印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints the figures for Diesel 50 Concrete Pump. The row to open is /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump. Diesel 50 prints it. The sheet prints 15 m³/h. Diesel 30’s output is 15 m³/h. Not on the Diesel 30 list used here. Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h on a 55 kW motor. Electric 60 is also 3300 kg and is an electric page. The shared numeral 50 does not share the 30 m³/h cell. The inquiry should say 6105 / 99 kW so it cannot be read as Diesel 60’s 144 kW 6105. Send your stone size with /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ to the contact page. The page description attaches 1 cm aggregate to that distance pair and does not add a separate maximum-aggregate specification row. If the output cell you want is 30 m³/h on a diesel trailer, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints it on Diesel 50: 6105 / 99 kW, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 450 m, Kawasaki 140, 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm and 3300 kg. The section title “Dynamic (absolute) Viscosity” comes from the source page and does not add a rating. No price is printed on the product page.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台印出的是印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30的数字。要打开的行是 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump。该页印 15 m³/h。150 m / 450 m。此处使用的柴油30列表上没有。柴油30的输送量是 15 m³/h。电动60也是 3300 kg，但是电动页。电动50在 55 kW 电机上印 26 m³/h。共同的数字 50 并不共享 30 m³/h 这一格。页面说明把 1 cm 骨料标在这组距离上，没有另加最大骨料规格行。询盘应写 6105 / 99 kW，这样才不会被读成柴油60的 144 kW 6105。把石子粒径和 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ 发到询盘页。如果你要的柴油拖泵输送量格是 30 m³/h，河北品锦机械（邢台）把它印在柴油50上：6105 / 99 kW、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 450 m、川崎 140、4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm、3300 kg。节标题「动力粘度」来自来源页，不另加额定值。产品页没有印价格。

body.en: This section is titled “Dynamic (absolute) Viscosity”. Diesel 50 Concrete Pump still prints the cells below. Diesel 50 prints it. Electric 50 prints 26 m³/h on a 55 kW motor. Send your stone size with /en/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ to the contact page.
body.zh: 本节标题是「动力粘度」。印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30下面这些格子仍是印出来的。电动50在 55 kW 电机上印 26 m³/h。共同的数字 50 并不共享 30 m³/h 这一格。把石子粒径和 /zh/products/diesel-50-concrete-pump/ 发到询盘页。

body.en: Under “Kinematic Viscosity”, Diesel 50 Concrete Pump contributes only the printed cells in this part. The sheet prints 15 m³/h. Electric 60 is also 3300 kg and is an electric page. The page description attaches 1 cm aggregate to that distance pair and does not add a separate maximum-aggregate specification row.
body.zh: 在「运动粘度」下，印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30这一节只放已印出的格子。该页印 15 m³/h。电动60也是 3300 kg，但是电动页。页面说明把 1 cm 骨料标在这组距离上，没有另加最大骨料规格行。

body.en: “Viscosity and Reference Temperature” titles this part of the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump note. The figures stay the printed ones. Diesel 30’s output is 15 m³/h. The shared numeral 50 does not share the 30 m³/h cell. If the output cell you want is 30 m³/h on a diesel trailer, Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints it on Diesel 50: 6105 / 99 kW, 30 MPa, hopper 0.4 m³, 150 m / 450 m, Kawasaki 140, 4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm and 3300 kg.
body.zh: 「粘度与参考温度」是印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30这一节的标题。数字仍以已印的为准。柴油30的输送量是 15 m³/h。此处使用的柴油30列表上没有。150 m / 450 m。

heading.zh: 其他 粘度 单位

body.en: For Diesel 50 Concrete Pump, the heading “Other Viscosity Units” does not replace a cell. Not on the Diesel 30 list used here. The inquiry should say 6105 / 99 kW so it cannot be read as Diesel 60’s 144 kW 6105. The photograph is an image from the source page https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-absolute-kinematic-viscosity-d_412.html.
body.zh: 对印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30而言，标题「其他 粘度 单位」并不替换任何格子。如果你要的柴油拖泵输送量格是 30 m³/h，河北品锦机械（邢台）把它印在柴油50上：6105 / 99 kW、30 MPa、料斗 0.4 m³、150 m / 450 m、川崎 140、4600 × 1650 × 1850 mm、3300 kg。询盘应写 6105 / 99 kW，这样才不会被读成柴油60的 144 kW 6105。配图来自来源页 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-absolute-kinematic-viscosity-d_412.html。

question.en: Does “Dynamic (absolute) Viscosity” replace Diesel 50 prints it?
question.zh: 「动力粘度」会替换「该页印 15 m³/h。」吗？

answer.en: No. Diesel 50 prints it remains the printed wording for Diesel 50 Concrete Pump.
answer.zh: 不会。该页印 15 m³/h。仍是印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30已印的说法。

question.en: Where does The sheet prints 15 m³/h belong on the Diesel 50 Concrete Pump row?
question.zh: 印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30这一行里，「150 m / 450 m。」放在哪里？

answer.en: It belongs on /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump, beside the other printed cells, not under a guessed heading.
answer.zh: 它属于 /products/diesel-50-concrete-pump，和其他已印格子在一起，不放到猜出来的标题下面。

question.en: What does “Kinematic Viscosity” add to Diesel 50 Concrete Pump?
question.zh: 「运动粘度」给印出 30 m³/h 的柴油页是柴油50，不是柴油30增加了什么？

answer.en: It is only the section title taken from https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-absolute-kinematic-viscosity-d_412.html. It does not add a performance figure.
answer.zh: 它只是取自 https://www.engineeringtoolbox.com/dynamic-absolute-kinematic-viscosity-d_412.html 的节标题，不增加性能数字。

question.en: Is a list price printed beside Diesel 50 prints it?
question.zh: 「该页印 15 m³/h。」旁边印了标价吗？
